scope: Outcome-blind four-route replacement for the infrastructure-incompatible hard MCTS task

replacement_design.selection_rule: Choose the next hard software-engineering task in the previously frozen Wave 2 sentinel tranche order.

effective_limits.wall_timeout_clock: absolute Unix wall time; includes laptop sleep

sandbox_budget.pricing_basis: same Daytona linear resource rates frozen for Gate 8 Wave 1
sandbox_budget.execution_policy: one four-route task with at most two concurrent Harbor trials; all sandboxes must be Harbor-managed and cleaned afterward

interpretation_guard: Use this task as a proportional replacement, not as evidence about the excluded MCTS task. If it also proves infrastructure-incompatible, replace it using a separately frozen cross-category hard-task rule rather than retrying.
